definition: The selected governing predicate applies exactly to powers counted by the existing narrow Power.Governing table or to Power.teach. It therefore permits the Matthew 28 teaching power to be used as the governing-power witness only with an institutional bridge calibrated to this same criterion.
note: An openly assumed analyst alternative, not attributed to Lumen gentium or the Gospel reports. The old fixed table deliberately excludes teaching and remains unchanged. Relabelling teaching as governing does not license applying the old bridge at the broader predicate.
